title: profileGrants
responsibility: Selects permission declarations of one grant kind without inferring access.

inputs.name: profileGrants.profile
inputs.description: Profile whose own grant list is filtered; no inheritance or normalization is performed.

inputs.name: profileGrants.kind
inputs.description: Exact grant discriminator to select; no default is supplied.

outputs.name: profileGrants
outputs.description: Native filtered collection containing only the requested kind, preserving filter method and species behavior.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Errors from supplied getters, collection methods or species constructors propagate unchanged.
